text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Whoa, "Discovered! 100 Wonders of the World"!? Ahaha, that sounds so fun!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! The ruins of Mohenjo-daro had technology so advanced you wouldn't believe it was ancient☆
And then, and then—?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
――... Ah!
It's almost time for training!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: B-But still, we have to solve the mystery of the downfall!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Marvelous Sunday skipped her training.
